title: Gcd iteration measure
statement: For a Boolean list $S$, define its measure as the binary size of the product of the natural numbers represented by the two components decoded from $S$, plus $1$ if the first represented number is smaller than the second, and plus $0$ otherwise.
caveat: The pair decoder and binary-value function are not defined in the supplied context.
